plan.notes: Official UH Manoa "Four-Year Academic Plan 2024-2025" template (Office of the Vice Provost for Academic Excellence program sheets). Templates publish course codes/designations and credit values but not full course titles; titles echo the official slot text. General Education designations (FW/FQ/FS/FG/DS/DH/DA/DB/DP/DY/DL, H/SL) modeled as choice slots per the UH General Education legend. Prerequisites are not published in the templates; none inferred. Source index: https://manoa.hawaii.edu/ovpae/programsheets/archives/2024-25/index.html
